title: Story premise ENT029: The Audience-Powered Curtain
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (cooperation). Hook: The show starts when all of us lift. Takeaway/theme: Distributing a task can make its timing manageable.
description: A puppet crew wants to reveal a show, but the curtain is tied to several short ropes scattered through the seats. Instead of one frantic operator chasing every rope, the crew invites each seated figure to hold a section and raise it together on a visible count.
